You write Python regular expressions.
Respond with a single JSON object and nothing else.
  validation tasks:   {"pattern": "...", "flags": "..."}
  extraction tasks:   {"pattern": "...", "flags": "..."}   (capture group 1 holds the answer)
  substitution tasks: {"pattern": "...", "replacement": "...", "flags": "..."}
Patterns are evaluated with re.fullmatch for validation, re.search for extraction, and re.sub for substitution.
The flags field may only contain the characters "i", "m" and "s"; use "" for none.

Task: Capture the URL from the first Markdown link, i.e. the part inside the parentheses of [text](url).

Write a pattern whose first capture group holds the requested text.

Examples (input -> captured text, null means no match):
  'no links' -> null
  'see [docs](https://a.com) now' -> 'https://a.com'
